mapper.select: SELECT bc.consult_no, bc.baby_no, bc.category, bc.situation, bc.ai_summary, bc.video_id, bc.video_title, bc.reg_time FROM tbl_baby_behavior_consult bc JOIN tbl_baby_info bi ON bc.baby_no = bi.baby_no WHERE bc.baby_no = #{babyNo} AND bi.email = #{email} ORDER BY bc.reg_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{skip}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_baby_behavior_consult bc JOIN tbl_baby_info bi ON bc.baby_no = bi.baby_no WHERE bc.baby_no = #{babyNo} AND bi.email = #{email}

SELECT bc.consult_no, bc.baby_no, bc.category, bc.situation, bc.ai_summary, bc.video_id, bc.video_title, bc.reg_time FROM tbl_baby_behavior_consult bc JOIN tbl_baby_info bi ON bc.baby_no = bi.baby_no WHERE bc.consult_no = #{consultNo} AND bi.email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_baby_behavior_consult (baby_no, category, situation, ai_summary, video_id, video_title) VALUES (#{babyNo}, #{category}, #{situation}, #{aiSummary}, #{videoId}, #{videoTitle})
